approval_evidence.quote: 08/16/2019 ORIG-1 Approval Type 1 - New Molecular Entity (NDA 212327, INREBIC FEDRATINIB HYDROCHLORIDE)

launch_evidence.quote: In August 2019, the FDA approved INREBIC ® (fedratinib) for the treatment of adult patients with intermediate-2 or high-risk primary or secondary (post-polycythemia) myelofibrosis (MF).

series_start_reason: Series starts 2020Q1, two quarters after launch. Celgene (CIK 816284) launched Inrebic after its August 2019 approval; Celgene's third-quarter 2019 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/816284/000110465919058070/tm1921268d1_ex99-1.htm) prints an Inrebic heading with U.S. 2, International '-', Worldwide 2 for the quarter. Celgene filed no fourth-quarter 2019 release (its last filing with Item 2.02 is dated 2019-10-31; BMS completed the acquisition on November 20, 2019), and BMS's fourth-quarter 2019 release prints Inrebic 5 covering only the post-close weeks (footnote '(b) | includes celgene product revenues from november 20, 2019 through december 31, 2019'). 2019Q4 therefore has no full-quarter figure; because a series must be contiguous, the single Celgene quarter (2019Q3) is not joined and the series begins with BMS's first full quarter.
series_end_reason: The fourth-quarter 2023 release (2024-02-02) is the last to print an Inrebic row. From the first-quarter 2024 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/14272/000001427224000094/q12024ex991-filing.htm) Inrebic is folded into an aggregate: '(a) Includes Nulojix, Onureg, Inrebic, Empliciti and royalty revenue'; no later release through 2026Q3 prints an Inrebic row.
search_log: Listed every filing (all forms) for CIK 0000014272 (Bristol-Myers Squibb) via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. the older 'files' pages; selected every 8-K/8-K/A whose items include 2.02 (105 filings, 2004-10-29 to 2026-10-29) and fetched every document in each filing's index.json except the cover document and R*.htm pages; product rows read from Exhibit 99.1 (the file name matching 'ex99.?1' or 'ex991'), whose first product table is the quarter table.

Row rule: first table row of the Exhibit 99.1 whose first cell begins with the product name and whose first figure cell is a number. 2015Q4-2022Q4 releases print worldwide quarter then same quarter a year earlier (2019Q4-2022Q4 also a summary table on the first page, which is the row read); from the 2023Q1 release the columns are U.S., Int'l, WW and the WW (third) figure is used.
Also listed CIK 0000816284 (Celgene) filings 2019-07-01 onward: 8-K Item 2.02 on 2019-07-30 and 2019-10-31, 10-Q 2019-07-30 and 2019-10-31; nothing with Item 2.02 after 2019-10-31.
Inrebic product row present in every BMS Exhibit 99.1 from 2019Q4 (partial, excluded) to 2023Q4.

Full-year checks (quarters against the twelve-month figure of the Q4 release): 2020: quarters sum to 55; twelve-month figure 55 (current column of the 2020Q4 release); 2021: quarters sum to 74; twelve-month figure 74 (current column of the 2021Q4 release); 2022: quarters sum to 85; twelve-month figure 85 (current column of the 2022Q4 release); 2023: quarters sum to 110; twelve-month figure 110 (current column of the 2023Q4 release)
